evidenceBoundary: Constructed correctly typed memberships and independent hand arithmetic, not original cohort rows, recovered author code, deployment or full-profile replication.

caught.fragmentationBoundary: Median close-to-open different-app lag and its reciprocal are disclosed, but no fragmentation normalization or zero-lag policy is implemented here. Completed response endpoints are supplied; missed-prompt, raw event matching and clocks are not inferred.

regret.tieBoundary: Tied maxima and empty label membership are source_undefined; no label/model/coder inference or regret-score operation.

s3.windowBoundary: Caller owns exact last-minute/last-day membership. No cadence, calendar, current/previous app selection, interface deltas, sensor/speaker alignment or authentication.

mapontap.boundary: Preserve supplied sample order and identities; no conversion to sensor memberships, one-second bins, 20-percent length-band resampling, DTW or clustering. Constant range remains source_undefined.

bjerre.primaryLocator: official rendered SAGE supplement zero-based pp0-1 lines20-30
bjerre.provenanceBoundary: The pinned receipt is a paraphrased official rendered-supplement locator index, not publisher PDF bytes or a local PDF digest. Raw geolocation, attendance/schedule, screen pairing, class overlap construction and scientific models remain outside this operation.
bjerre.formula: Select original session duration >=35s, sum qualified disjoint class overlap separately per course, divide by that course's positive class-time exposure, multiply100, then unweighted mean over supplied courses.
